blind.description: A stylized ritual sun standard or emblem stand consisting of a circular stepped grey stone base, a vertical cylindrical reddish-brown wooden or copper rod with raised ornamental rings/collars, and a golden sunburst emblem mounted on top. The sunburst features a central raised circular dome surrounded by pointed radial rays, identical on front and back. All surfaces are clean, solid, stylized, and continuous without gaps, melted sections, or floating components. It rests flat on its circular stone pedestal.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a circular grey base concentric with the central pole, surmounted by a horizontal winged/spiked golden crossbar forming the top edge of the sunburst medallion.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 80% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 4.5 ft / 1.4 m tall), with a slender profile approximately 1.5 ft wide across the sun emblem.

notes: Height proportion somewhat wider than catalog ratio, but absolute height matches intended 6.0 ft
